title: COBRA election period, duration and cost
facts: A qualified beneficiary generally has at least 60 days to elect COBRA, measured from the later of loss of coverage or provision of the COBRA election notice.
COBRA following termination or reduction in hours generally lasts up to 18 months; certain other qualifying events can permit up to 36 months, and special extension rules can apply.
The beneficiary may generally be required to pay the full group-plan premium plus up to a 2% administrative charge.
After electing COBRA, the initial premium payment is generally due within 45 days under federal rules.
